layout.spacing_system: Generous (p-6, p-8, p-12) to feel premium and uncluttered
layout.dashboard_grid: Control Room Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6
layout.border_radius: Cards: rounded-2xl, Buttons: rounded-full or rounded-xl for organic feel

component_rules.cards: Flat solid background (#FFFFFF), 1px subtle border (#E5E8E5). Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
component_rules.buttons: Primary CTA uses Deep Moss Green (#2C4C3B) with pure white text. Hover state must explicitly lighten or darken.
component_rules.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized. Soft borders, rounded-xl, high contrast focus states.
component_rules.charts: Use Recharts. Use natural palette: Moss Green for savings/income, Terracotta for expenses, Ochre for needs. NO generic violet/blue.
component_rules.ai_advisor: Do not use generic 'robot' or 'sparkle' icon. Use a leaf or organic shape. Assistant chat bubbles in pale sage (#F4F7F4) with dark text.

image_urls.description: Minimalist leaf graphic for brand identity.
Minimalist green gradient corner for auth pages.

pages.dashboard: Overview with total balance, monthly income/expense summary, 50/30/20 rule visual breakdown, recent transactions, and AI advisor widget.
pages.auth: Split layout. Left: minimal login form. Right: image background with welcoming text.
pages.budget: Detailed view of category allocations. Card-based layout.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' fonts are loaded via Google Fonts. Use Tailwind config to set custom colors. Implement layout using generous padding (p-6, p-8) and rounded-2xl cards. Apply data-testid to all interactive elements.
